H3168H.name: Ezekiel
H3168H.desc: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return
H3168H.brief: Prophet during Babylonian exile; author of the Book of Ezekiel.
H3168H.short: Ezekiel was a prophet during the Babylonian exile who authored the Book of Ezekiel and served as a sign to the people of Israel.

H3152.name: Izliah
H3152.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3152.short: Izliah was a Benjamite, one of the sons of Elpaal.

H3156G.name: Izrahiah
H3156G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3156G.short: Izrahiah, a son of Uzzi, was a descendant of Issachar and a clan head.

H3150.name: Izziah
H3150.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3150.brief: Descendant of Parosh; agreed to put away foreign wife.
H3150.short: Izziah, a descendant of Parosh, was among those who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's reforms.

H3199J.name: Jachin
H3199J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3199J.brief: Head of a priestly division during David's reign.
H3199J.short: Jachin was the head of the twenty-first priestly division organized by King David.

H3199I.name: Jachin
H3199I.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H3199I.brief: Priest who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.
H3199I.short: Jachin was a priest who resided in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H3199G.name: Jachin
H3199G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3199G.brief: Son of Simeon; founder of the Jachinites clan.
H3199G.short: Jachin (or Jarib), a son of Simeon, was the founder of the Jachinites clan within the tribe of Simeon.

H3189H.name: Jahath
H3189H.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3189H.brief: Levite, descendant of Shimei, son of Gershon.
H3189H.short: Jahath was a Levite, a descendant of Shimei, and a grandson of Gershon.

H3189J.name: Jahath
H3189J.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3189J.brief: Levite, son of Shelomoth, descendant of Izhar.
H3189J.short: Jahath was a Levite, the son of Shelomoth, and a descendant of Izhar.

H3189G.name: Jahath
H3189G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3189G.brief: Son of Reaiah, descendant of Judah through Shobal.
H3189G.short: Jahath was the son of Reaiah and a descendant of Judah through Shobal.

H3189K.name: Jahath
H3189K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3189K.brief: Levite who supervised repairs in Josiah's temple restoration.
H3189K.short: Jahath, along with Obadiah, were Levites from the Merarites who faithfully supervised the workmen repairing the temple during Josiah's reign.

H3166G.name: Jahaziel
H3166G.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3166G.brief: Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
H3166G.short: Jahaziel, a Benjamite warrior, was one of the mighty men who joined David at Ziklag while he was hiding from Saul.

H3166H.name: Jahaziel
H3166H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3166H.brief: Levite priest who played the trumpet regularly.
H3166H.short: Jahaziel, along with Benaiah, were Levite priests who regularly blew the trumpets before the ark of the covenant.

H3166I.name: Jahaziel
H3166I.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3166I.brief: Levite, son of Hebron, during David's reign.
H3166I.short: Jahaziel, a Levite and son of Hebron, was a chief of the Hebronites during the reign of David.

H3166J.name: Jahaziel
H3166J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3166J.brief: Levite who prophesied Jehoshaphat's victory over his enemies.
H3166J.short: Jahaziel, a Levite and descendant of Asaph, prophesied by the Spirit of the Lord that Jehoshaphat would have victory over his enemies.

H3166K.name: Jahaziel
H3166K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3166K.brief: Descendant of Shecaniah; returned with Ezra from Babylon.
H3166K.short: Jahaziel, a descendant of Shecaniah, was one of the men who returned with Ezra from Babylon to Jerusalem.

H3164.name: Jahdiel
H3164.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3164.brief: Mighty warrior and head of a father's house in Manasseh.
H3164.short: Jahdiel was a mighty warrior and head of a father's house in the half-tribe of Manasseh, east of the Jordan.

H3163.name: Jahdo
H3163.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3163.short: Jahdo, a son of Buz, was a descendant of Gad and a clan head.

H3177.name: Jahleel
H3177.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3177.brief: Son of Zebulun, grandson of Jacob, and a clan leader.
H3177.short: Jahleel, son of Zebulun, was a grandson of Jacob and a clan leader.

H3181.name: Jahmai
H3181.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3181.short: Jahmai, a son of Tola, was a descendant of Issachar and a clan head.

H3183.name: Jahzeel
H3183.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3183.brief: Son of Naphtali, grandson of Jacob, and a clan leader.
H3183.short: Jahzeel (or Jahziel), son of Naphtali, was a grandson of Jacob and a clan leader.

H3167.name: Jahzeiah
H3167.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3167.brief: Opposed Ezra's command for Israelites to divorce foreign wives.
H3167.short: Jahzeiah, along with three others, opposed Ezra's order for Israelites to divorce their foreign wives.

H3170.name: Jahzerah
H3170.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H3170.short: Jahzerah was a priest who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.

H3120G.name: Javan
H3120G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3120G.brief: Son of Japheth; ancestor of Greek people
H3120G.short: Javan, the ancestor of the Greek people, was a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah.

H3151.name: Jaziz
H3151.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3151.brief: Hagrite in charge of David's flocks
H3151.short: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of King David's flocks.

H3165G.name: Jehdeiah
H3165G.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3165G.brief: Levite descendant of Amram during David's reign
H3165G.short: Jehdeiah was a Levite descendant of Amram who served during the reign of King David.

H3165H.name: Jehdeiah
H3165H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3165H.brief: Officer in charge of King David's donkeys
H3165H.short: Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of King David's donkeys.

H3168G.name: Jehezkel
H3168G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3168G.brief: Head of the 20th priestly division under David
H3168G.short: Jehezkel was the head of the 20th priestly division during the reign of King David.

H3171G.name: Jehiel
H3171G.desc: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3171G.brief: Levitical musician during the reign of King David
H3171G.short: Jehiel was a Levitical musician who played the harp and lyre during the reign of King David.

H3171I.name: Jehiel
H3171I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3171I.short: Jehiel, King David's uncle, was a counselor and a scribe.

H3171H.name: Jehiel
H3171H.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3171H.brief: Levite leader during the reign of King David
H3171H.short: Jehiel, also known as Jahath, was a Levite leader who served during the reign of King David.

forms.meaning: “God shall save alive” or “swept away of God”

H3171J.name: Jehiel
H3171J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3171J.brief: Son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah
H3171J.short: Jehiel was one of the sons of King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

H3171L.name: Jehiel
H3171L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3171L.brief: Levite appointed by King Hezekiah to distribute offerings
H3171L.short: Jehiel was a Levite appointed by King Hezekiah to distribute the offerings and tithes in the temple.

H3171M.name: Jehiel
H3171M.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3171M.brief: Temple officer during King Josiah's Passover celebration
H3171M.short: Jehiel, along with Zechariah and Jehiel, was a temple officer who gave animals for King Josiah's Passover offerings.

H3171O.name: Jehiel
H3171O.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3171O.brief: A leader who married a foreign wife
H3171O.short: Jehiel, one of the descendants of Elam, was guilty of marrying a foreign wife during the Exile.

H3171P.name: Jehiel
H3171P.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3171P.brief: Priest who married a foreign woman during the Exile
H3171P.short: Jehiel, one of the descendants of Harim, was a priest who married a foreign woman during the Exile.

H3171Q.name: Jehiel
H3171Q.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3171Q.brief: Israelite who married a foreign woman during the Exile
H3171Q.short: Jehiel, one of the descendants of Elam, married a foreign woman during the Exile but agreed to put her away.

H3171N.name: Jehiel
H3171N.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3171N.brief: Leader who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra
H3171N.short: Jehiel, son of Shechaniah, was one of the leaders who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

H3169G.name: Jehizkiah
H3169G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3169G.brief: Ephraimite leader who opposed taking Judean captives
H3169G.short: Jehizkiah, an Ephraimite leader, opposed taking Judean captives during the reign of King Ahaz of Judah.

H3141H.name: Joram
H3141H.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3141H.brief: King of N. Israel, son of Ahab
H3141H.short: Joram (or Jehoram), the son of Ahab, was king of Northern Israel for twelve years.

H3160.name: Jehubbah
H3160.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3160.short: Jehubbah was a descendant of Asher mentioned in the genealogy recorded in 1 Chronicles.

H3171K.name: Jehuel
H3171K.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3171K.brief: A Levite who helped cleanse the temple under Hezekiah.
H3171K.short: Jehuel was a Levite from the family of Heman who participated in the cleansing of the temple during King Hezekiah's reign.

H3195G.name: Jetur
H3195G.desc: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3195G.short: Jetur, one of the twelve sons of Ishmael.

H3153.name: Jezaniah
H3153.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3153.brief: A leader of the Judean forces
H3153.short: Jezaniah, also known as Azariah, was a leader of the Judean forces after the fall of Jerusalem.

H3149.name: Jeziel
H3149.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3149.brief: A Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
H3149.short: Jeziel, a Benjamite, was one of the warriors who joined David at Ziklag.

H3156H.name: Jezrahiah
H3156H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3156H.brief: A leader of the singers at the wall dedication
H3156H.short: Jezrahiah was one of the leaders of the singers during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

H3157J.name: Jezreel
H3157J.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3157J.brief: A son of Hur in the genealogy of Judah
H3157J.short: Jezreel was a son of Hur, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H3157K.name: Jezreel
H3157K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3157K.brief: A symbolic name given to Hosea's son
H3157K.short: Jezreel was the name given to Hosea's son as a sign of God's judgment on the house of Jehu.

H3101L.name: Joash
H3101L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3101L.brief: A Benjaminite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
H3101L.short: Joash, the son of Shemaah the Gibeathite, was a Benjaminite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.

H3135H.name: Joash
H3135H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3135H.brief: An official in charge of David's olive and sycamore trees
H3135H.short: Joash the Abiezrite was responsible for King David's olive and sycamore trees in the Shephelah.

H3101K.name: Joash
H3101K.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3101K.brief: A descendant of Shelah in the tribe of Judah
H3101K.short: Joash was a descendant of Shelah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H3135G.name: Joash
H3135G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3135G.brief: A descendant of Benjamin through Becher
H3135G.short: Joash was a descendant of Benjamin through Becher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

H3101H.name: Joash
H3101H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3101H.brief: Son of King Ahab of Israel
H3101H.short: Joash, the son of King Ahab, was imprisoned by his father for a prophecy against him.

H3101I.name: Joash
H3101I.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3101I.brief: King of Judah, son of Ahaziah
H3101I.short: Joash (Jehoash), son of Ahaziah, became king of Judah at age seven and reigned for forty years.

H3101J.name: Joash
H3101J.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3101J.brief: King of Israel, son of Jehoahaz
H3101J.short: Joash (Jehoash), son of Jehoahaz, reigned as king of Israel for sixteen years.

H3101G.name: Joash
H3101G.brief: The father of Gideon, a judge of Israel
H3101G.short: Joash, the father of Gideon, supported his son's actions in tearing down the altar of Baal.

H3103K.name: Jobab
H3103K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3103K.brief: A son of Elpaal, descendant of Benjamin
H3103K.short: Jobab, a descendant of Benjamin, was one of the sons of Elpaal.

H3103J.name: Jobab
H3103J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3103J.brief: A son of Shaharaim and Hodesh
H3103J.short: Jobab was one of the sons born to Shaharaim and his wife Hodesh in the genealogy of Benjamin.

H3103G.name: Jobab
H3103G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3103G.brief: A son of Joktan, descendant of Shem
H3103G.short: Jobab, a descendant of Shem through Joktan, is mentioned in the Table of Nations.

H3103H.name: Jobab
H3103H.desc: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3103H.brief: A king of Edom, son of Zerah of Bozrah
H3103H.short: Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, was an early king of Edom who reigned before Israel had a king.

H3103I.name: Jobab
H3103I.brief: King of Madon, who joined forces against Joshua
H3103I.short: Jobab, the king of Madon, was one of the northern kings who allied against Israel during the conquest of Canaan.

H3115.name: Jochebed
H3115.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3115.brief: Mother of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam
H3115.short: Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, married her nephew Amram and became the mother of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

H3133.name: Joed
H3133.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3133.brief: A Benjaminite who resettled in Jerusalem
H3133.short: Joed, a Benjaminite, was among those who resettled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H3100M.name: Joel
H3100M.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H3100M.brief: The brother of Nathan, one of David's mighty men
H3100M.short: Joel, the brother of Nathan, was one of the mighty men who fought valiantly for King David.

H3100N.name: Joel
H3100N.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3100N.brief: A Gershomite Levite during the reign of David
H3100N.short: Joel, a Levite of the Gershomite clan, was appointed by David to help transport the ark of the covenant.

H3100O.name: Joel
H3100O.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3100O.brief: A Gershonite Levite during David's organization of the Levites
H3100O.short: Joel, a descendant of Ladan from the Gershonite clan, was a Levite during David's time.

H3100P.name: Joel
H3100P.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3100P.brief: A ruler of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead
H3100P.short: Joel was appointed as the ruler over the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead during David's reign.

H3100H.name: Joel
H3100H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3100H.brief: A Simeonite mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
H3100H.short: Joel is listed in the genealogy of Judah as a descendant of Simeon.

H3100K.name: Joel
H3100K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3100K.short: Joel was a chief of the Gadites who lived in the territory of Bashan.

H3100I.name: Joel
H3100I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3100I.short: Joel is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Reuben as a descendant of Shemaiah.

H3100J.name: Joel
H3100J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3100J.brief: Father of Shema living in Reubenite lands
H3100J.short: Joel, a father of Shema who lived in Reuben and also neighbouring Gad.

H3100L.name: Joel
H3100L.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3100L.brief: A son of Izrahiah from the tribe of Issachar
H3100L.short: Joel was one of the five sons of Izrahiah, a descendant of Issachar, known for their bravery.

H3100G.name: Joel
H3100G.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H3100G.brief: Samuel's firstborn son who judged Israel
H3100G.short: Joel, the firstborn son of Samuel, served as a judge in Israel but did not walk in his father's ways.

H3100Q.name: Joel
H3100Q.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3100Q.brief: A Kohathite Levite during Hezekiah's temple restoration
H3100Q.short: Joel, a Levite of the Kohathite clan, participated in the purification of the temple during King Hezekiah's reign.

H3100R.name: Joel
H3100R.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3100R.brief: An Israelite who married a foreign woman during the Exile
H3100R.short: Joel was among the Israelites who had married foreign women and pledged to put them away during Ezra's reforms.

H3100T.name: Joel
H3100T.desc: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3100T.brief: A prophet of Judah and the author of the Book of Joel
H3100T.short: Joel, the son of Pethuel, was a prophet of Judah who delivered a message of judgment and hope.

H3100S.name: Joel
H3100S.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3100S.brief: A Benjaminite leader in Jerusalem after the Exile
H3100S.short: Joel, the son of Zichri, was a Benjaminite leader in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H3132.name: Joelah
H3132.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3132.brief: A Benjaminite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
H3132.short: Joelah, a Benjaminite warrior, was among those who joined David at Ziklag while he was fleeing from Saul.

H3134.name: Joezer
H3134.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3134.brief: A Benjaminite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
H3134.short: Joezer, a Korahite warrior, was among the Benjaminites who joined David at Ziklag while he was fleeing from Saul.

H3109H.name: Joha
H3109H.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3109H.brief: One of David's mighty warriors from the Tizite clan
H3109H.short: Joha the Tizite was one of David's mighty warriors, known for his bravery and military skill.

H3109G.name: Joha
H3109G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3109G.short: Joha was a son of Beriah and a member of the tribe of Benjamin.

H3110I.name: Johanan
H3110I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3110I.brief: A descendant of David through the line of Jehoiachin
H3110I.short: Johanan is listed in the genealogy of David as a descendant of King Jehoiachin.

H3110J.name: Johanan
H3110J.desc: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3110J.brief: A Levite in the lineage of Elkanah
H3110J.short: Johanan was a Priest in the lineage of Elkanah, the father of Samuel.

H3110G.name: Johanan
H3110G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3110G.brief: A Judean military leader after the fall of Jerusalem
H3110G.short: Johanan, the son of Kareah, was a prominent Judean military leader who played a significant role in the events following the fall of Jerusalem to the Babylonians.

H3110K.name: Johanan
H3110K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3110K.brief: A leader who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra
H3110K.short: Johanan, the son of Hakkatan, was one of the leaders who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

H3110L.name: Johanan
H3110L.desc: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
H3110L.brief: A high priest during the Persian period
H3110L.short: Johanan served as a high priest during the Persian period, as recorded in the genealogies of the priests and Levites.

H3111H.name: Joiada
H3111H.desc: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
H3111H.brief: A high priest, son of Eliashib
H3111H.short: Joiada served as a high priest during the Persian period, succeeding his father Eliashib.

H3111G.name: Joiada
H3111G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3111G.brief: Son of Paseah, who repaired the Old Gate
H3111G.short: Joiada, the son of Paseah, repaired the Old Gate during the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls under Nehemiah.

H3113.name: Joiakim
H3113.desc: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
H3113.brief: A high priest, son of Jeshua
H3113.short: Joiakim served as a high priest during the early Persian period, succeeding his father Jeshua.

H3114G.name: Joiarib
H3114G.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H3114G.brief: A priestly family that returned from Babylonian exile
H3114G.short: Joiarib (or Jehoiarib) was a priestly family that returned from the Babylonian exile and settled in Jerusalem.

H3114H.name: Joiarib
H3114H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3114H.brief: A man of understanding sent by Ezra
H3114H.short: Joiarib was one of the men of understanding sent by Ezra to bring Levites to Jerusalem.

H3114I.name: Joiarib
H3114I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3114I.brief: A descendant of Judah who settled in Jerusalem
H3114I.short: Joiarib, a descendant of Judah through Perez, settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H3137.name: Jokim
H3137.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3137.brief: A descendant of Judah through Shelah
H3137.short: Jokim was a descendant of Judah through Shelah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H3122G.name: Jonadab
H3122G.desc: David's nephew living at the time of United Monarchy
H3122G.brief: Nephew of David, friend and advisor to Amnon
H3122G.short: Jonadab, also known as Jonathan, was the son of David's brother Shimeah and a friend and advisor to Amnon, David's eldest son.

H3124.name: Jonah
H3124.desc: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3124.brief: Prophet swallowed by fish, preached to Nineveh
H3124.short: Jonah, a prophet from Gath-hepher, was sent to preach to Nineveh.

H3129G.name: Jonathan
H3129G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3129G.brief: Son of Jada, descendant of Judah
H3129G.short: One of the descendants of Judah, Jonathan was the son of Jada.

H3129I.name: Jonathan
H3129I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3129I.brief: Opposed divorcing foreigners, with Jahzeiah and Meshullam
H3129I.short: Jonathan, along with Jahzeiah and Meshullam, opposed Ezra's demand to put away foreign wives.

H3129H.name: Jonathan
H3129H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3129H.brief: Descendant of Adaiah who returned from exile
H3129H.short: Jonathan, of the descendants of Adaiah, was among those who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile.

H3129L.name: Jonathan
H3129L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3129L.brief: Son of Kareah, came to Gedaliah at Mizpah
H3129L.short: Jonathan son of Kareah was one of the army officers who came to Gedaliah at Mizpah after the fall of Jerusalem.

H3129J.name: Jonathan
H3129J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3129J.brief: Head of priestly family of Malluchi
H3129J.short: Jonathan was the head of the priestly family of Malluchi during the high priesthood of Joiakim.

H3129K.name: Jonathan
H3129K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3129K.brief: Priest who participated in dedication of Jerusalem's wall
H3129K.short: Jonathan, a priest, was among those who blew trumpets at the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

H3139.name: Jorah
H3139.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3139.brief: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem
H3139.short: The descendants of Jorah (or Hariph) were among the exiles who returned to Jerusalem from Babylon.

H3140.name: Jorai
H3140.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3140.brief: A chief of the half-tribe of Manasseh
H3140.short: Jorai was a clan chief of the half-tribe of Manasseh during the reign of King Jotham of Judah.

H3141I.name: Joram
H3141I.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3141I.brief: A Levite during the reign of King David
H3141I.short: Joram was a Levite who served during the reign of King David.

H3141G.name: Joram
H3141G.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H3141G.brief: Son of King Toi, brought gifts to David
H3141G.short: Joram (or Hadoram), son of King Toi of Hamath, brought gifts to King David after David's defeat of Hadadezer.

H3130I.name: Joseph
H3130I.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3130I.brief: Son of Asaph, a musician in David's time
H3130I.short: Joseph, a son of Asaph, was a musician who served during King David's reign.

H3130J.name: Joseph
H3130J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3130J.brief: An Israelite who married a foreign woman
H3130J.short: Joseph was among the Israelites who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

H3130G.name: Joseph
H3130G.desc: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3130G.brief: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt
H3130G.short: Joseph, Jacob's son, rose to power in Egypt and saved his family during a famine.

H3130K.name: Joseph
H3130K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3130K.brief: Head of the priestly family of Shebaniah
H3130K.short: Joseph was the head of the priestly family of Shebaniah during the high priesthood of Joiakim.

H3130H.name: Joseph
H3130H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3130H.brief: Representative of Issachar among the spies
H3130H.short: Joseph son of Igal represented the tribe of Issachar among the twelve spies sent to Canaan.

H3144.name: Joshah
H3144.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3144.brief: A Simeonite leader during Hezekiah's reign
H3144.short: Joshah was one of the leaders from the tribe of Simeon during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H3146G.name: Joshaphat
H3146G.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3146G.brief: One of David's mighty warriors from Mithan
H3146G.short: Joshaphat the Mithnite was listed among David's mighty warriors.

H3146H.name: Joshaphat
H3146H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3146H.brief: A priest who blew trumpets before the ark
H3146H.short: Joshaphat, along with other priests, blew trumpets before the ark of the covenant during its transfer to Jerusalem.

H3145.name: Joshaviah
H3145.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3145.brief: One of David's mighty warriors from Eliahba's sons
H3145.short: Joshaviah, a son of Elnaam, was listed among David's mighty warriors.

H3143.name: Joshibiah
H3143.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3143.brief: A Simeonite leader during Hezekiah's reign
H3143.short: Joshibiah was one of the leaders from the tribe of Simeon during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H3131.name: Josiphiah
H3131.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3131.brief: Father of Shelomith, a returning exile
H3131.short: Josiphiah was the father of Shelomith, who was among the exiles who returned with Ezra to Jerusalem.

H3147I.name: Jotham
H3147I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3147I.brief: A son of Jahdai, a Calebite
H3147I.short: Jotham was a son of Jahdai, who was a wife of Caleb.

H3147H.name: Jotham
H3147H.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3147H.brief: King of Judah and son of Uzziah
H3147H.short: Jotham, the son of Uzziah, was a king of Judah who reigned for sixteen years.

H3147G.name: Jotham
H3147G.brief: Youngest son of Gideon who escaped Abimelech's massacre
H3147G.short: Jotham, the youngest son of Gideon, was the only one to escape when Abimelech killed his seventy brothers.

H3107I.name: Jozabad
H3107I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3107I.brief: A Manassite leader who joined David at Ziklag
H3107I.short: One of two men called Jozabad who, along with other Manassite leaders, joined David at Ziklag when he was returning to fight against the Philistines.

H3107J.name: Jozabad
H3107J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3107J.brief: A Manassite leader who joined David at Ziklag
H3107J.short: One of two men called Jozabad who, along with other Manassite leaders, joined David at Ziklag when he was returning to fight against the Philistines.

H3107H.name: Jozabad
H3107H.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3107H.brief: A Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
H3107H.short: Jozabad, a Benjamite warrior, was one of the mighty men who joined David at Ziklag.

H3107K.name: Jozabad
H3107K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3107K.brief: A Levite appointed as an overseer during Hezekiah's reign
H3107K.short: Jozabad, a Levite, was one of the overseers appointed by King Hezekiah to distribute the contributions to the priests and Levites.

H3107L.name: Jozabad
H3107L.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3107L.brief: A Levite who contributed to the Passover celebration
H3107L.short: Jozabad, along with other Levitical leaders, generously provided animals for the Passover offerings during King Josiah's reign.

H3107N.name: Jozabad
H3107N.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3107N.brief: A priest who married a foreign woman
H3107N.short: Jozabad was one of the priests who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to put them away.

H3107O.name: Jozabad
H3107O.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3107O.brief: A Levite who married a foreign woman
H3107O.short: Jozabad was one of the Levites who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to put them away.

H3107M.name: Jozabad
H3107M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3107M.brief: A priest who weighed the silver and gold offerings
H3107M.short: Jozabad, along with Noadiah, was a priest appointed to weigh the silver, gold, and vessels brought as offerings to the temple.

H3107Q.name: Jozabad
H3107Q.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3107Q.brief: A Levite leader in charge of outside work
H3107Q.short: Jozabad, one of the leaders of the Levites, was in charge of the outside work of the house of God.

H3107P.name: Jozabad
H3107P.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3107P.brief: A Levite who helped explain the Law to the people
H3107P.short: Jozabad was one of the Levites who helped the people understand the Law as Ezra read it aloud.

H3108.name: Jozacar
H3108.desc: Ammonite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3108.brief: One of the servants who killed King Joash
H3108.short: Jozacar (or Zabad), along with Jehozabad, was one of the servants who conspired against and killed King Joash of Judah.

H3136G.name: Jozadak
H3136G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H3136G.brief: A priest whose descendants married foreign women
H3136G.short: Among the descendants of Jozadak, some priests were found to have married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

H3106.name: Jubal
H3106.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H3106.brief: Father of musicians who play the lyre and pipe
H3106.short: Jubal was the father of all who play the lyre and pipe.

H3142.name: Jushab-hesed
H3142.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3142.short: Jushab-hesed was one of the sons of Zerubbabel, a descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah.

H3120H.name: Greece
H3120H.brief: A nation and culture, often in opposition to Israel
H3120H.short: Greece (Javan), a nation and culture mentioned in both the Old and New Testaments.

H3195H.name: Jetur
H3195H.brief: A descendant of Ishmael and a region in Syria
H3195H.short: Jetur, a descendant of Ishmael, also a region (Ituraea) mentioned in the New Testament.

H3157I.name: Jezreel
H3157I.brief: A son of Saul's son Jonathan, also called Merib-baal
H3157I.short: Jezreel, a son of Jonathan, who was also known as Merib-baal (<ref="2Sa.4.4">2Sa.4.4</ref>).

H3157G.name: Jezreel
H3157G.brief: A town in Judah, home of David's wife Ahinoam
H3157G.short: Jezreel, a town in Judah, home of Ahinoam, one of David's wives (<ref="Joshua 15:56; 1Sa.25.43">Joshua 15:56; 1Sa.25.43</ref>).

H3157H.name: Jezreel
H3157H.brief: A city in Issachar, associated with Ahab and Jezebel
H3157H.short: Jezreel, a city in Issachar, known for its association with King Ahab and Queen Jezebel.

H3157L.name: Jezreel Valley
H3157L.brief: A fertile valley in northern Israel, site of many battles
H3157L.short: The Jezreel Valley, a strategically important and fertile valley in northern Israel, was the site of several significant battles in the Bible.

H3192.name: Jotbah
H3192.brief: The hometown of Amon's mother, Meshullemeth
H3192.short: Jotbah, the hometown of Meshullemeth; mother of King Amon of Judah (<ref="2Ki.21.19">2Ki.21.19</ref>).

H3193.name: Jotbathah
H3193.brief: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey
H3193.short: Jotbathah, a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey, known for its streams of water (<ref="Numbers 33:33-34; Deu.10.7">Numbers 33:33-34; Deu.10.7</ref>).

H3194.name: Juttah
H3194.brief: A town in the hill country of Judah, a Levitical city
H3194.short: Juttah, a town in the hill country of Judah, was designated as a Levitical city (<ref="Joshua 15:55; 21:16">Joshua 15:55; 21:16</ref>).

H3199H.name: Jachin
H3199H.brief: One of two bronze pillars in Solomon's Temple
H3199H.short: Jachin was the name given to one of the two bronze pillars that stood at the entrance of Solomon's Temple (<ref="1Ki.7.21; 2Ch.3.17">1Ki.7.21; 2Ch.3.17</ref>).

H3128.name: Jonath-elem-rechokim
H3128.brief: A musical term in the superscription of Psalm 56
H3128.short: Jonath-elem-rechokim, meaning "Dove on Far-off Terebinths," is a musical term or phrase found in the superscription of Psalm 56, possibly indicating the melody or musical setting to which the psalm was to be sung.
